explanation: Point is physically possible: W=1.52 GeV > eta production threshold (m_p+m_eta≈1.486 GeV), Q2=0.6 GeV2 within the eta grid (0.3–5.0), cos theta*=-0.4 and phi*=45 deg are within full ranges.
